#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PREPARED ONLY. A separate root resource release is required after builds,
# actual-feature audit, candidate checks, and this driver's review/checks.
# Usage: HARNESS_SHA256=... abba.sh RUNNER_310 HARNESS OUT_ROOT
set -euo pipefail
[[ $# -eq 3 ]] || exit 2
WT=$(realpath "$1") HARNESS=$(realpath "$2") OUT=$(realpath "$3")
PREP=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
export RUNNER_SHA=3102768788b9acba3ae177739483caf0771bfa82
: "${HARNESS_SHA256:?frozen prebuilt main harness hash required}"
: "${CANDIDATE_SHA:?exact reviewed candidate commit required}"
[[ $CANDIDATE_SHA =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && $CANDIDATE_SHA != "$RUNNER_SHA" ]]
[[ $(head -n 1 "$OUT/binaries/candidate/source-identity.txt") == "$CANDIDATE_SHA" ]]
[[ $(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD) == "$RUNNER_SHA" && -z $(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) ]]
[[ ! -e $OUT/logs/abba.exit && ! -e $OUT/window-start ]]
mkdir -p "$OUT/logs"
exec >"$OUT/logs/abba.log" 2>&1
export RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK=$HOME/.local/state/rustbgpd-host.lock
source "$WT/tests/soak/host-lock.sh"
acquire_rustbgpd_host_lock
export RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK_FD
ACTIVE=''
trap 'exit 143' TERM
trap 'exit 130' INT
finish() {
    local rc=$? child_rc
    trap - EXIT
    if [[ -n $ACTIVE ]]; then
        kill -TERM "$ACTIVE" 2>/dev/null || true
        if wait "$ACTIVE"; then child_rc=0; else child_rc=$?; fi
        printf '%s\n' "$child_rc" >"$OUT/logs/interrupted-wrapper.exit"
        ((rc!=0)) || rc=1
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$OUT/logs/abba.exit"
    date -Is >"$OUT/logs/abba.reaped"
    exit "$rc"
}
trap finish EXIT
cp "$PREP/compare-arms.py" "$OUT/compare-arms-as-run.py"
python3 "$OUT/compare-arms-as-run.py" "$OUT" >"$OUT/logs/actual-features.log" 2>&1
cp "$PREP/abba.sh" "$OUT/abba-driver-as-run.sh"
cp "$PREP/prebuilt-cell.sh" "$OUT/prebuilt-cell-as-run.sh"
cp "$PREP/extract-cells.py" "$OUT/extract-cells-as-run.py"
sha256sum "$OUT/abba-driver-as-run.sh" "$OUT/prebuilt-cell-as-run.sh" \
    "$OUT/extract-cells-as-run.py" "$OUT/compare-arms-as-run.py" \
    "$WT/bench/scale/reloadstall/gen-scenario.py" \
    "$WT/bench/scale/host-quiet.sh" "$WT/tests/soak/fd-headroom.sh" "$HARNESS" \
    "$OUT/binaries/baseline/rbgp" >"$OUT/instruments.sha256"
for arm in baseline candidate; do
    [[ $(cat "$OUT/binaries/$arm/build-stage.exit") == 0 && $(cat "$OUT/binaries/$arm/cargo-build.exit") == 0 ]]
    (cd "$OUT/binaries/$arm" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)
done
# Declare shape and native validity before the first cell; performance result
# compares process medians/ranges, without pooling reloads as independent n.
cat >"$OUT/acceptance.json" <<'JSON'
{"baseline":"3102768788b9acba3ae177739483caf0771bfa82","schedule":["baseline-r1","candidate-r1","candidate-r2","baseline-r2"],"peers":700,"prefixes":400400,"k":1,"rounds_per_process":3,"processes_per_arm":2,"control_secs":30,"quiet":true,"native_exits":0,"sessions_up":700,"parse_errors":0,"readiness_misses":0,"required_table_eor_checkpoints_per_process":6,"required_observer_requests_per_process":12,"replay_gap_cutoff_ms":null,"daemon_cpus":"12-32,34-39","engine_cpus":"40-63","performance_claim_requires_reviewed_process_comparison":true}
JSON
python3 - "$OUT" "$CANDIDATE_SHA" "$HARNESS_SHA256" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);data=json.loads((root/'acceptance.json').read_text())
data['candidate']=sys.argv[2];data['common_harness_sha256']=sys.argv[3]
data['source_trees']={arm:(root/f'binaries/{arm}/source-identity.txt').read_text().splitlines()[1] for arm in ('baseline','candidate')}
(root/'acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
sha256sum "$OUT/acceptance.json" >"$OUT/acceptance.sha256"
date -Is >"$OUT/window-start"
for leg in baseline-r1 candidate-r1 candidate-r2 baseline-r2; do
    arm=${leg%-r?}
    export DAEMON_SHA256
    DAEMON_SHA256=$(awk '$2=="rustbgpd" {print $1}' "$OUT/binaries/$arm/SHA256SUMS")
    [[ $DAEMON_SHA256 =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
    date -Is >"$OUT/logs/$leg.started"
    bash "$OUT/prebuilt-cell-as-run.sh" "$leg" "$OUT/binaries/$arm/rustbgpd" "$HARNESS" "$WT" "$OUT" >"$OUT/logs/$leg.log" 2>&1 &
    ACTIVE=$!
    if wait "$ACTIVE"; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
    ACTIVE=''
    printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$OUT/logs/$leg.exit"
    date -Is >"$OUT/logs/$leg.finished"
    ((rc==0)) || exit "$rc"
done
sha256sum -c "$OUT/instruments.sha256" >"$OUT/logs/end-instruments.log" 2>&1
sha256sum -c "$OUT/acceptance.sha256" >"$OUT/logs/end-acceptance.log" 2>&1
for arm in baseline candidate; do (cd "$OUT/binaries/$arm" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); done
python3 "$OUT/extract-cells-as-run.py" "$OUT" >"$OUT/logs/native-extraction.log" 2>&1
date -Is >"$OUT/window-finish"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Prepared prebuilt K=1 converged-rejoin cell; no build or instrument mutation.
# Usage: under one continuous canonical host lock, supply frozen env and run:
# bash prebuilt-cell.sh CELL_NAME DAEMON HARNESS RUNNER_TREE OUT_ROOT
# Required env: DAEMON_SHA256 HARNESS_SHA256 RUNNER_SHA RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK_FD.
# Both arms use one frozen HARNESS
# and clean RUNNER_TREE with matched-package daemon build provenance archived.
set -euo pipefail
[[ $# -eq 5 ]] || { echo "expected CELL_NAME DAEMON HARNESS RUNNER_TREE OUT_ROOT" >&2; exit 2; }
NAME=$1 DAEMON=$(realpath "$2") HARNESS=$(realpath "$3") WT=$(realpath "$4") OUT=$(realpath -m "$5")
[[ $NAME =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$ ]] || exit 2
: "${DAEMON_SHA256:?frozen daemon hash required}" "${HARNESS_SHA256:?frozen common instrument hash required}"
: "${RUNNER_SHA:?exact frozen runner commit required}" "${RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK_FD:?inherited canonical lock fd required}"
[[ $RUNNER_SHA =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && $RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK_FD =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 2
[[ $(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD) == "$RUNNER_SHA" && -z $(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain) ]] || exit 2
RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK=${RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK:-$HOME/.local/state/rustbgpd-host.lock}
export RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK
[[ $RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK == "$HOME/.local/state/rustbgpd-host.lock" ]] || exit 2
[[ $(readlink "/proc/$$/fd/$RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK_FD") == "$RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK" ]] || exit 2
flock -n "$RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK_FD" || exit 75
if flock -n "$RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK" true; then
    echo "canonical host lock must already be held by the outer campaign" >&2
    exit 2
fi
CELL=$OUT/$NAME
[[ ! -e $CELL ]] || { echo "new cell path required" >&2; exit 2; }
mkdir -p "$CELL"
log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$*" >>"$CELL/cell.log"; }
verify_binaries() {
    printf '%s  %s\n%s  %s\n' "$DAEMON_SHA256" "$DAEMON" "$HARNESS_SHA256" "$HARNESS" |
        sha256sum -c - >>"$CELL/binary-integrity.log" 2>&1
}
DPID='' HPID='' SCEN='' FORCED_KILL=0
stop_group() {
    local pid=$1 secs=$2 i rc
    kill -TERM -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((i=0; i<secs*10; i++)); do
        kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
        sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        FORCED_KILL=1
        log "cleanup forced kill pid=$pid"
        kill -KILL -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if wait "$pid"; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
    return "$rc"
}
cleanup() {
    local original=$? rc
    trap - EXIT
    if [[ -n $HPID ]]; then
        if stop_group "$HPID" 15; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
        printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$CELL/harness-cleanup.exit"
        ((rc==0)) || original=1
    fi
    if [[ -n $DPID ]]; then
        if stop_group "$DPID" 60; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
        printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$CELL/daemon-cleanup.exit"
        ((rc==0)) || original=1
    fi
    [[ -z $SCEN ]] || rm -rf -- "$SCEN"
    printf '%s\n' "$FORCED_KILL" >"$CELL/forced-kill.txt"
    if ((original==0 && FORCED_KILL)); then original=1; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$original" >"$CELL/cell.exit"
    exit "$original"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
trap 'exit 130' INT
verify_binaries
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "$WT/tests/soak/fd-headroom.sh"
require_fd_headroom
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "$WT/bench/scale/host-quiet.sh"
export RUSTBGPD_HOST_QUIET_TIMEOUT_SECS=${RUSTBGPD_HOST_QUIET_TIMEOUT_SECS:-1800}
wait_for_rustbgpd_quiet_host "$CELL/quiet.tsv"
PEERS=700 PREFIXES=400400 K=1 ROUNDS=3 CONTROL_SECS=30
PORT=17986 MPORT=19186 DAEMON_CPUS=12-32,34-39 ENGINE_CPUS=40-63
SCEN=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/readiness-cell.XXXXXX")
chmod 700 "$SCEN"
sha256sum "$WT/bench/scale/reloadstall/gen-scenario.py" >"$CELL/generator.sha256"
GEN_CONVERGED_REJOIN=1 python3 "$WT/bench/scale/reloadstall/gen-scenario.py" "$PEERS" "$SCEN" "$PORT" >"$CELL/generator.log" 2>&1
sed -i "s#prometheus_addr = \"127.0.0.1:9179\"#prometheus_addr = \"127.0.0.1:$MPORT\"#" "$SCEN/config.toml"
rg -q "127.0.0.1:$MPORT" "$SCEN/config.toml"
cp -- "$SCEN/config.toml" "$SCEN/member.rpol" "$SCEN/gen-a.rpol" "$SCEN/gen-b.rpol" "$CELL/"
(cd "$CELL" && sha256sum config.toml member.rpol gen-a.rpol gen-b.rpol >generated-inputs.sha256)
"$DAEMON" --check "$SCEN/config.toml" >"$CELL/config-check.log" 2>&1
log "cell start peers=$PEERS prefixes=$PREFIXES k=$K rounds=$ROUNDS"
(cd "$SCEN" && exec setsid taskset -c "$DAEMON_CPUS" "$DAEMON" "$SCEN/config.toml") >"$CELL/daemon.log" 2>&1 &
DPID=$!
t0=$SECONDS
until curl -fsS --max-time 1 "http://127.0.0.1:$MPORT/readyz" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    kill -0 "$DPID" 2>/dev/null || { log "daemon died at start"; exit 1; }
    ((SECONDS-t0 < 60)) || { log "daemon not ready in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 0.2
done
(cd "$SCEN" && RELOADSTALL_REJOIN_METRICS_ADDR=127.0.0.1:$MPORT exec setsid taskset -c "$ENGINE_CPUS" \
    "$HARNESS" "$PEERS" "$PREFIXES" "$PORT" "$DPID" "$SCEN/member.rpol" "$SCEN/gen-a.rpol" \
    "$SCEN/gen-b.rpol" 0 "$CONTROL_SECS" --flapstorm "$K" --flap-rounds "$ROUNDS" --converged-rejoin) \
    >"$CELL/reloadstall.log" 2>&1 &
HPID=$!
t0=$SECONDS timed_out=0
while kill -0 "$HPID" 2>/dev/null; do
    if ! kill -0 "$DPID" 2>/dev/null; then log "daemon died during harness"; timed_out=1; break; fi
    if ((SECONDS-t0 >= 3600)); then log "cell timeout"; timed_out=1; break; fi
    sleep 1
done
if ((timed_out)); then
    if stop_group "$HPID" 15; then hrc=0; else hrc=$?; fi
else
    if wait "$HPID"; then hrc=0; else hrc=$?; fi
fi
HPID=''
printf '%s\n' "$hrc" >"$CELL/harness.exit"
if curl -fsS --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:$MPORT/metrics" >"$CELL/metrics-final.prom" 2>"$CELL/metrics-final.stderr"; then mrc=0; else mrc=$?; fi
printf '%s\n' "$mrc" >"$CELL/metrics.exit"
if stop_group "$DPID" 60; then drc=0; else drc=$?; fi
DPID=''
printf '%s\n' "$drc" >"$CELL/daemon.exit"
verify_binaries
sha256sum -c "$CELL/generator.sha256" >>"$CELL/input-integrity.log" 2>&1
(cd "$SCEN" && sha256sum -c "$CELL/generated-inputs.sha256") >>"$CELL/input-integrity.log" 2>&1
log "cell done harness_rc=$hrc daemon_rc=$drc metrics_rc=$mrc timeout=$timed_out forced_kill=$FORCED_KILL"
((hrc==0 && drc==0 && mrc==0 && timed_out==0 && FORCED_KILL==0)) || exit 1
log "cell pass"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepared fixed-shape native controls and complete observer replay pairs."""
import csv
from datetime import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); cells=['baseline-r1','candidate-r1','candidate-r2','baseline-r2']
phases=[(r,p) for r in range(1,4) for p in ('disconnected','settled')]
all_pairs=[]
for cell_name in cells:
    cell=root/cell_name
    for name in ('cell','harness','daemon','metrics'):
        assert (cell/f'{name}.exit').read_text().strip()=='0', (cell_name,name)
    assert (cell/'forced-kill.txt').read_text().strip()=='0'
    lines=(cell/'reloadstall.log').read_text().splitlines()
    rows=list(csv.reader(line for line in lines if line.startswith('converged_rejoin_csv,')))
    assert len(rows)==3
    for round_number,row in enumerate(rows,1):
        assert row[1:5]==[str(round_number),'700','1','400400']
        assert float(row[5])>0 and float(row[6])>=float(row[5])
        assert float(row[7])>=0 and int(row[8])>0
        assert row[10:12]==['700','0']
    checks=[]
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith('converged_table_checkpoint,'):
            record=dict(part.split('=',1) for part in line.split(',')[1:])
            assert record['observers']=='1:2' and record['unique']=='399828' and record['eor']=='present'
            checks.append((int(record['round']),record['phase']))
    assert checks==phases, (cell_name,checks)
    observed=[]
    for line in (cell/'daemon.log').read_text().splitlines():
        if not line.lstrip().startswith('{'):
            continue
        event=json.loads(line)
        fields=event.get('fields',{})
        message=fields.get('message','')
        assert event.get('level')!='ERROR', (cell_name,event)
        assert not ('readiness' in message.lower() and 'fail' in message.lower()), (cell_name,event)
        if message=='handling route refresh request' and fields.get('peer') in {'127.1.0.2','127.1.0.3'}:
            assert fields.get('afi')=='Ipv4' and fields.get('safi')=='Unicast'
            observed.append({'timestamp':event['timestamp'],'peer':fields['peer']})
    # K=1's two surviving observers are explicitly refreshed at both native
    # checkpoints in each of three rounds. Pair by exact known program order,
    # not by a favorable duration cutoff; extra/missing requests invalidate it.
    assert len(observed)==12, (cell_name,len(observed))
    for index,(round_number,phase) in enumerate(phases):
        first,second=observed[2*index:2*index+2]
        assert {first['peer'],second['peer']}=={'127.1.0.2','127.1.0.3'}
        parse=lambda value:datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z','+00:00'))
        gap=(parse(second['timestamp'])-parse(first['timestamp'])).total_seconds()*1000
        assert gap>=0
        all_pairs.append({'cell':cell_name,'round':round_number,'phase':phase,
                          'first':first,'second':second,'inter_handler_gap_ms':gap})
(root/'observer-replay-pairs.json').write_text(json.dumps(all_pairs,indent=2)+'\n')
print('four native cells, twelve rounds, 24 complete replay pairs (48 requests); all gaps retained')

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PREPARED ONLY. Run one arm only after root releases its build slot.
# Usage: build-arm.sh baseline|candidate SOURCE_TREE EXACT_SHA CACHE OUT_ROOT
# Source-tree metadata creation and candidate qualification are separate.
set -euo pipefail
[[ $# -eq 5 && ( $1 == baseline || $1 == candidate ) ]] || exit 2
ARM=$1 TREE=$(realpath "$2") SHA=$3 CACHE=$(realpath "$4") OUT=$(realpath -m "$5")
PREP=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
[[ $SHA =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
[[ $(git -C "$TREE" rev-parse HEAD) == "$SHA" && -z $(git -C "$TREE" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) ]]
BASE=3102768788b9acba3ae177739483caf0771bfa82
if [[ $ARM == baseline ]]; then [[ $SHA == "$BASE" ]]; fi
git -C "$TREE" merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" "$SHA"
export RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK=$HOME/.local/state/rustbgpd-host.lock
source "$TREE/tests/soak/host-lock.sh"
acquire_rustbgpd_host_lock
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$CACHE RUSTBGPD_BUILD_LOCK=$CACHE/build.lock CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4
unset RUSTFLAGS CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS
source "$TREE/scripts/build-lock.sh"
acquire_rustbgpd_build_lock
DEST=$OUT/binaries/$ARM
[[ ! -e $DEST ]]
mkdir -p "$DEST"
exec >"$DEST/build-driver.log" 2>&1
trap 'exit 143' TERM
trap 'exit 130' INT
finish() { local rc=$?; trap - EXIT; printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$DEST/build-stage.exit"; date -Is >"$DEST/build-stage.finished"; exit "$rc"; }
trap finish EXIT
date -Is >"$DEST/build-stage.started"
printf 'source_worktree=%s\nsource_commit=%s\ncargo_target_dir=%s\ncommand=%s\n' "$TREE" "$SHA" "$CACHE" 'cargo build --release --locked -j 4 -p rustbgpd -p rustbgpctl' >"$DEST/build-identity.txt"
cp "$PREP/build-arm.sh" "$DEST/build-driver-as-run.sh"
cp "$PREP/snapshot-arm.py" "$DEST/snapshot-as-run.py"
rustc -vV >"$DEST/toolchain.txt"
cargo -V >>"$DEST/toolchain.txt"
git -C "$TREE" rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' >"$DEST/source-identity.txt"
git -C "$TREE" diff "$BASE" "$SHA" >"$DEST/source-diff.patch"
git -C "$TREE" diff --exit-code "$BASE" "$SHA" -- Cargo.lock Cargo.toml '**/Cargo.toml'
git -C "$TREE" ls-files -z -- '*.rs' '*.proto' Cargo.toml Cargo.lock '**/Cargo.toml' '**/Cargo.lock' >"$DEST/input-refresh.nul"
(cd "$TREE" && xargs -0 -r touch -- <"$DEST/input-refresh.nul")
date -Is >"$DEST/input-refreshed-at"
sha256sum "$DEST/input-refresh.nul" >"$DEST/input-refresh.sha256"
rc=0
(cd "$TREE" && taskset -c 40-63 cargo build --release --locked -j 4 -p rustbgpd -p rustbgpctl) >"$DEST/build.log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$DEST/cargo-build.exit"
((rc==0)) || exit "$rc"
[[ -z $(git -C "$TREE" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) ]]
cp "$CACHE/release/rustbgpd" "$CACHE/release/rbgp" "$DEST/"
(cd "$DEST" && sha256sum rustbgpd rbgp >SHA256SUMS)
"$DEST/rustbgpd" --version >"$DEST/binary-versions.txt"
"$DEST/rbgp" --version >>"$DEST/binary-versions.txt"
# Capture BEFORE any subsequent build changes a shared-cache fingerprint.
python3 "$PREP/snapshot-arm.py" "$CACHE" "$DEST" >"$DEST/actual-capture.log" 2>&1
(cd "$TREE" && cargo tree --locked --offline --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
    --edges normal,build --prefix depth --no-dedupe --format '{p}|{f}' \
    -p rustbgpd -p rustbgpctl) >"$DEST/normal-build-tree.txt" 2>"$DEST/normal-build-tree.stderr"
python3 - "$TREE" "$DEST" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
source, dest = sys.argv[1:]
p=Path(dest)
(p/'normal-build-tree.normalized.txt').write_text((p/'normal-build-tree.txt').read_text().replace(source,'<SOURCE>'))
PY
(cd "$DEST" && sha256sum normal-build-tree.normalized.txt source-identity.txt build-driver-as-run.sh snapshot-as-run.py >provenance.sha256)
chmod a-w "$DEST/rustbgpd" "$DEST/rbgp" "$DEST/SHA256SUMS"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepared adaptation of the retained dependency-signature closure capture."""
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import shutil
import sys

cache, destination = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:])
root = cache / 'release/.fingerprint'
release = cache / 'release'
dest = destination / 'actual'
dest.mkdir()
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
binary = destination / 'rustbgpd'
actual = release / 'rustbgpd'
assert sha(binary) == sha(actual)
# Cargo's published executable and deps artifact are hard links. Bind the
# actual filename before identifying its fingerprint rather than guessing it.
artifacts = [p for p in (release/'deps').glob('rustbgpd-*')
             if p.is_file() and p.samefile(actual)]
assert len(artifacts) == 1, f'cannot uniquely bind actual daemon artifact: {artifacts}'
entry = root / artifacts[0].name / 'bin-rustbgpd.json'
assert entry.is_file()
lookup = collections.defaultdict(list)
for p in root.glob('*/*.json'):
    signature = p.with_suffix('')
    if signature.exists():
        try:
            value = int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(signature.read_text().strip()), 'little')
        except ValueError:
            continue
        lookup[value].append(p)

def closure(include_build):
    pending, found, missing = [entry], {}, []
    while pending:
        p = pending.pop()
        if p in found:
            continue
        data = json.loads(p.read_text())
        found[p] = data
        for dep in data['deps']:
            if not include_build and dep[1] == 'build_script_build':
                continue
            matches = lookup.get(dep[3], [])
            if not matches:
                missing.append({'from': str(p.relative_to(root)), 'dependency': dep})
            pending.extend(matches)
    return found, missing

all_units, all_missing = closure(True)
normal_units, normal_missing = closure(False)
inventory = {}
def retain(src, rel):
    dst = dest / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
    inventory[str(rel)] = {'source': str(src), 'sha256': sha(dst),
                           'source_mtime_ns': src.stat().st_mtime_ns, 'bytes': dst.stat().st_size}

for p in all_units:
    for source in (p, p.with_suffix('')):
        retain(source, pathlib.Path('fingerprints') / source.relative_to(root))
    # Keep existing Cargo build-script output metadata as well as its full
    # fingerprint/signature chain. Do not archive unrelated cache contents.
    for name in ('output', 'stderr', 'root-output', 'invoked.timestamp'):
        output = release / 'build' / p.parent.name / name
        if output.is_file():
            retain(output, pathlib.Path('build') / p.parent.name / name)
report = {
    'method': 'Bind actual daemon release/deps inode and immutable SHA256; follow dependency fingerprint integers via little-endian signatures; retain every matching unit before the next cache build.',

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build qualification only. No harness/native cell is executed here.
# Usage: build-common-harness.sh FROZEN_RUNNER CACHE OUT_ROOT
set -euo pipefail
[[ $# -eq 3 ]] || exit 2
TREE=$(realpath "$1") CACHE=$(realpath "$2") OUT=$(realpath "$3")
PREP=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
SHA=3102768788b9acba3ae177739483caf0771bfa82
[[ $(git -C "$TREE" rev-parse HEAD) == "$SHA" && -z $(git -C "$TREE" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) ]]
export RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK=$HOME/.local/state/rustbgpd-host.lock
source "$TREE/tests/soak/host-lock.sh"
acquire_rustbgpd_host_lock
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$CACHE RUSTBGPD_BUILD_LOCK=$CACHE/build.lock CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4
unset RUSTFLAGS CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS
source "$TREE/scripts/build-lock.sh"
acquire_rustbgpd_build_lock
DEST=$OUT/harness
[[ ! -e $DEST ]]
mkdir -p "$DEST"
exec >"$DEST/build-driver.log" 2>&1
trap 'exit 143' TERM
trap 'exit 130' INT
finish() { local rc=$?; trap - EXIT; printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$DEST/build-stage.exit"; date -Is >"$DEST/build-stage.finished"; exit "$rc"; }
trap finish EXIT
date -Is >"$DEST/build-stage.started"
printf 'source_worktree=%s\nsource_commit=%s\ncargo_target_dir=%s\ncommand=%s\n' "$TREE" "$SHA" "$CACHE" 'cargo build --profile scale --locked -j 4 -p reloadstall' >"$DEST/build-identity.txt"
cp "$PREP/build-common-harness.sh" "$DEST/build-driver-as-run.sh"
git -C "$TREE" rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}' >"$DEST/source-identity.txt"
rustc -vV >"$DEST/toolchain.txt"
cargo -V >>"$DEST/toolchain.txt"
git -C "$TREE" ls-files -z -- '*.rs' '*.proto' Cargo.toml Cargo.lock '**/Cargo.toml' '**/Cargo.lock' >"$DEST/input-refresh.nul"
(cd "$TREE" && xargs -0 -r touch -- <"$DEST/input-refresh.nul")
date -Is >"$DEST/input-refreshed-at"
sha256sum "$DEST/input-refresh.nul" >"$DEST/input-refresh.sha256"
(cd "$TREE" && sha256sum bench/scale/reloadstall/src/main.rs bench/scale/reloadstall/README.md bench/scale/reloadstall/Cargo.toml bench/scale/reloadstall/gen-scenario.py Cargo.toml Cargo.lock) >"$DEST/source-inputs.sha256"
rc=0
(cd "$TREE" && taskset -c 40-63 cargo build --profile scale --locked -j 4 -p reloadstall) >"$DEST/build.log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$DEST/cargo-build.exit"
((rc==0)) || exit "$rc"
[[ -z $(git -C "$TREE" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) ]]
cp "$CACHE/scale/reloadstall" "$DEST/reloadstall"
(cd "$DEST" && sha256sum reloadstall >SHA256SUMS)
cmp "$CACHE/scale/reloadstall" "$DEST/reloadstall"
chmod a-w "$DEST/reloadstall" "$DEST/SHA256SUMS"
(cd "$DEST" && sha256sum source-identity.txt source-inputs.sha256 build-driver-as-run.sh toolchain.txt >provenance.sha256)
printf 'frozen common harness build qualified; no native workload executed\n'
